description: Queue handler workflow.gate_resolved: moves workflow instances when a hard gate resolves. Platform tables only; no model-table writes.
The model's 'root orchestrator': legal_hold_checker and the i9_section2_due timer. Reads only; moves workflow instances.

Starts and advances a hire on a person's behalf: the API's start-hire, enter-application and request-consent actions. Opens the requisition (job_requisition) and moves the workflow; the flow's own workers do the rest.
Starts an exit on a person's behalf: the API's initiate-termination action (termination has no agent writer in the model; HR initiates it). Moves the workflow; the flow's own workers do the rest.
